title: Urinary polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon metabolites and Crohn’s disease activity: the mediating role of oxidative stress
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00114E, Paper
Shu Xu, Liangle Yang, Yapan Liu, Danping Xiong, Wenjun Yin, Siran Zhu, Linlin Liu, Lei Zhao, Huan Wang, Lei Tu, Kaifang Zou, Tao Bai, X. H. Hou, Liangru Zhu, Zhiyue Xu
Background: Exposure to polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) is linked to chronic inflammation. However, the impact of PAHs on inflammatory activity of Crohn’s disease (CD) and the potential mechanism remains unclear....
